name: Astral Quartz Filament
description: Thread-fine crystal pulled from meteor glass seams.
specialEffects: Used to craft precision arcane foci and star-metal weapon bindings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Astral Quartz Filament under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Astral Refinery protocol before storage.
